shared_elements: carved stone monolith / standing anthropomorphic figure
frontal human face with eyes and nose in relief
body/torso rendered on a slab-like column
incised linear patterning on the stone surface
circular or disc-shaped motif on the body
justification: Both are vertical monolithic stone sculptures with a frontal face at the top over a broad slab body bearing incised motifs, including circular/disc-like elements on the torso, so the general head-over-body arrangement corresponds. The rendering differs sharply, however: A is deeply modelled in pale stone with bold three-dimensional eyes, mouth and limbs and a stacked multi-figure composition, while B is a flat dark slab whose features and body ornaments are shallow, schematic incisions with no comparable plastic volume.
